pushkaralu.title: Godavari Pushkaralu
pushkaralu.subtitle: A sacred celebration occurring once every 12 years when planet Jupiter enters the zodiac sign of Leo (Simha Rasi).
pushkaralu.significanceDesc: Pushkaralu is believed to bring celestial purity to the sacred Godavari. Taking a holy dip at sanctified ghats washes away past deeds, bestowing blessings and spiritual liberation.
pushkaralu.historyDesc: Observed since prehistoric times, the Pushkaram cycle unites saints, scholars, and pilgrims across Bharata. Eastern Chalukyas, Kakatiyas, and modern Andhra administrations have continuously enriched its riverfront infrastructure.
guidelines: Always take holy bath only at designated steps marked by safety barricades.
Follow instructions from local police, volunteers, and certified lifeguards.
Keep ghats and the sacred river clean. Avoid single-use plastics and chemical soaps.
Supervise elderly family members and children closely amidst congregations.
Utilize digital QR audio guides at each heritage location for cultural guidance.
pushkaralu.scheduleDesc: The Maha Pushkaram occurs once every 144 years, while the regular Godavari Pushkaram is celebrated every 12 years with great reverence across Rajahmundry, Kovvur, and Bhadrachalam.
